title: Bounded buffer with conditions
summary: The same producer/consumer, now with one mutex and two condition variables.
hints: Two conditions: `has_room` (the producer waits on it while `count == SLOTS`) and `has_data` (the consumer waits on it while `count == 0`). Each side signals the OTHER condition after changing `count`.
Always `while`, never `if`, around `pthread_cond_wait`. Track the largest `count` ever seen (inside the lock) to prove the buffer never overflowed.
